Its definite singular form keeps the oath on one known city, while its head-noun role locks {{ar:ٱلْأَمِينِ}} ({{tr:al-amīni}}) into the same phrase. Lexically, the active local branch is bounded settled place: the word can range through city, land, territory, and residence, but here the demonstrative and security adjective select the inhabited secure-city sense. That still leaves spatial breadth; the oath is not a mere map label but a marked, settled ground, and the compact b-l-d sound profile helps the phrase move from open pointing into bounded place. As a noun-only anchor, it presents place as a given locus rather than as an event being performed. The noun also makes the oath sequence turn from produce (95:1) and mountain (95:2) into a social place, and it becomes the final spatial frame before the human-creation claim in 95:4. Its pairing with the security root recalls secure-city formulations (14:35; 2:126), while the local construction states the city as sworn object rather than petition; the same city term also stands beside the contrasting oath frame in 90:1-2.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَمِينِ}} ({{tr:al-amīni}}) completes the oath object as an adjective, not as a separate predicate. Its definiteness, genitive case, number, and gender agree with {{ar:ٱلْبَلَدِ}} ({{tr:al-baladi}}), so security belongs inside the sworn phrase itself. The adjective keeps both secure and trustworthy pressure: the city is safe and also reliable, almost protector-like, while the local noun frame keeps that force attached to place rather than turning it into a human belief verb. Its safety field also makes the city feel like a sanctuary toward which protection-seeking can move, and its trust field includes the ability to hold what is entrusted, while the local form remains a place adjective. This makes the secure-city formula declarative in 95:3 rather than petitionary as in 14:35, with the city-security pair also resonating with 2:126. The same adjective can mark trustworthiness across categories, including messenger figures (81:21; 44:18), but here that quality is assigned to the city. As the last word before the answer in 95:4, it is the oath triad's semantic and acoustic landing point; its final cadence ties back to the earlier oath endings, forward to the later human response of belief in 95:6, and onward to the closing judgment frame in 95:8.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun at word 2 is directly qualified by the adjective at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: A bounded tract is not merely located; settled security and trust become the condition governing its enclosure. Boundary and confidence therefore form one spatial-social mechanism.

activation_trace.role: The bounded-land image supplies an enclosure whose inside/outside distinction can carry protection.
Settled security and trust supply both freedom from fear and the reliable relation that makes the enclosure safe.

changed_reading.before: A demonstrative reference to a familiar city described as safe.
changed_reading.after: A bounded domain whose very boundary organizes a settled relation of protection and trust.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The resident-place branch of the noun and the trustworthy-or-trusted scope of the adjective meet in the same nominal phrase.
baseline_models.mechanism: The adjective can be agentive rather than merely passive: the city is not only protected but acts as a trustee that reliably holds residents, goods, promises, and safe-conduct.

activation_trace.role: Residence and staying supply the durable human occupancy over which a civic trust can operate.
The trusted or trustworthy thing image turns the adjective into a custodial capacity, not only a condition of being unharmed.

changed_reading.before: The city is the passive recipient of safety.
changed_reading.after: The city is a reliable civic custodian that makes residence and entrusted relations possible.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A direct branch of the noun names the chest and front hollow, while the adjective supplies heart-settling security.
baseline_models.mechanism: The place can be carried as an embodied center: a chest-like front or hollow within which composure settles. Geographic enclosure and bodily interior coexist without requiring either to erase the other.

activation_trace.role: The chest and front-hollow image supplies a bodily enclosure and central receiving space.
Heart-settling security supplies the composure housed in that chest-like center.

changed_reading.before: The demonstrative points only to an external urban location.
changed_reading.after: The external city also resonates as a protected chest-space in which fear can settle into trust.

context_deltas.mechanism: Edible fruit and oil that can serve as provision make urban security metabolic and distributive. The enclosure remains trustworthy not only through a boundary but through a surrounding chain of cultivation, extraction, storage, and transfer.

activation_trace.role: The bounded tract supplies the receiving and distributing node of the material system.
Settled security becomes the social effect of dependable access to sustenance.
The edible-fruit image supplies a direct consumable input to the city's security.
Oil as food, provision, and gift supplies a storable and transferable resource linking nourishment to social exchange.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies edible fruit and oil-as-provision; I infer a supply chain that helps produce civic security. Alternatively, the items may be coordinate oath emblems or place markers with no material causal arrow.

changed_reading.before: The city is secure as a static protected location.
changed_reading.after: The city is secure as a provisioned node whose dependable food and exchange flows help settle fear.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding edge, precinct, and stopping-limit images sharpen the city's boundedness into a threshold system. Security is produced at the approach and crossing of a limit, not merely enjoyed in an undifferentiated interior.

activation_trace.role: Bounded land supplies the inside/outside topology that the threshold images articulate.
Security supplies the protected condition achieved by governing approach to the boundary.
Nearness to a precinct supplies the approach-zone around what is protected.

structural_cues: The mountain term immediately precedes the demonstrative city.
The focus phrase itself joins a bounded-place noun to a security adjective.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies precinct-nearness and a stopping-or-crossing limit; I infer that the city's security is enacted at a governed threshold. Alternatively, the mountain can remain a proper landmark unrelated to civic jurisdiction.

changed_reading.before: Safety is a quality spread uniformly across the city.
changed_reading.after: Safety is a threshold achievement: the city is a protected precinct whose approaches and crossings are regulated.

context_deltas.mechanism: Residence and trust are activated against two neighboring possibilities: departure from human familiarity into wildness and a place in which no one is present. The secure city becomes a maintained human habitat rather than simply terrain without danger.

activation_trace.role: Staying and residence supply the inhabited pole of the contrast.
Trust and freedom from fear supply the relation that makes continued co-presence livable.
Departure beyond human familiarity supplies the wild outside against which civic inhabitation appears.

structural_cues: The unpeopled or wild branch possibilities occur immediately before a demonstratively present city.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured creation, visible humanity, goodness, and upright equilibrium turn the bounded secure place into a civic analogue of formed humanity. Boundary is its contour, trust its internal balance, and human presence the life for which that form is fitted.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The secure town as trust-place and later faith prototype.** Lexical evidence: ب ل د B001, bounded tract/place; ء م ن B001, settled security and trust; ء م ن B002 in 95:6, trusting assent/confirmation. Structural cue: the same root ء م ن appears as adjective أمين here and as verb آمنوا in the exception. Assigned role: the town's security becomes the environmental form of what believers later enact inwardly. Abductive move: I infer that the packet maps place-quality onto human response: the secure place models the trust that saves from the descent. Reading change: "secure town" becomes a prototype of faith as settled trust, not merely a description of civic safety.

2. **A bounded tract that can also be wilderness, grave, or exposed earth.** Lexical evidence: ب ل د B001 includes inhabited/uninhabited land, wilderness, cemetery/grave, dust, and exposed open space; س ف ل B001/B004 in 95:5, lowness and downward motion. Structural cue: the secure town precedes human creation and then return to the lowest. Assigned role: البلد supplies a bounded earthly field that can hold both habitation/security and grave-like/exposed endpoints. Abductive move: I supply the causal field: the same "land" in which humans are secured is also the earthward destination when vertical dignity fails. Reading change: the ayah's البلد is not only a safe civic site; it also quietly contains dust, exposure, and burial as latent counter-images.

3. **The chest/front image makes the city a body-zone.** Lexical evidence: ب ل د B002, chest and front hollow; خ ل ق B003/ق و م B011 in 95:4, well-proportioned form and stature; ح ك م B006 in 95:8, jaw/bridle restraint. Structural cue: a body-root network appears after the town: human form, stature, descent, and final restraint/judgment. Assigned role: البلد can be read as a front hollow/chest, making "this secure place" also a guarded bodily center. Abductive move: I infer a body-city analogy from the packet's proximity of bounded place and human form. Reading change: the secure town can read as the protected front/core of a body or community, not only an external location.

4. **Confusion and collapse as the town's shadow-reading.** Lexical evidence: ب ل د B005, confusion and collapse of composure; ب ل د B007, dullness; ك ذ ب B002 in 95:7, declaring false; ب ع د B008, depth of judgment. Structural cue: after the secure oath, 95:7 asks what still makes one deny after all this. Assigned role: the same root that names the town holds a branch for perplexed collapse, activated by the later denial-question. Abductive move: I infer that refusal after evidence is not mere opposition but a collapse of perception/judgment in the very place that should secure trust. Reading change: "secure town" carries a counterfactual: security can be answered by trust or by dull, confused denial.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 95:6 retroactively changed أمين from civic safety into a precursor of آمنوا: the same security/trust root moves from place-quality to human response. 95:7 then activated the shadow branches of ب ل د—confusion, dullness, collapse—because denial after the secure sequence looks like losing the very composure/security the town embodies. The city therefore became double: an external protected tract and an internal test of whether security becomes faith or collapses into bewilderment.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Security becoming enacted trust.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ء م ن/B001` includes safety, trust, entrusted things, and the trustworthy; the same root recurs as the verb in 95:6, where `ء م ن/B002` supplies trusting assent and confirmation. **Structural cue:** the root first qualifies a place as *amīn* and later qualifies the excepted people by what they do, *āmanū*. **Assigned role:** the city embodies settled trust externally, while the later verb makes trust an internal and communal act. **Abductive move:** the packet supplies recurrence but not mutual causation; I infer a trust loop in which a trustworthy order shelters assent and assenting people sustain trustworthy order. **Reading change:** *al-amīn* means more than danger-free: the city is trust-bearing and entrusted, and its security has an ethical human correlate.

2. **A bounded jurisdiction awaiting judgment.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ب ل د/B001` supplies a bounded tract, and fixed `ء م ن/B001` supplies reliable security. Later `د ي ن/B006` supplies the city as a place of ordered authority, while `ح ك م/B002` supplies adjudication among people (95:8). **Structural cue:** the demonstrative “this” sharply locates the bounded place; the surah later moves through recompense (95:6), reckoning (95:7), and judges (95:8). **Assigned role:** the land defines jurisdictional bounds, and *amīn* guarantees the trust under which judgment can operate. **Abductive move:** the packet does not call the city a court; I infer a civic-legal mechanism from bounded place → ordered authority → adjudication. **Reading change:** the oath names not only geography but a protected sphere of accountable social order.

3. **Stable residence as a foil to human displacement.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ب ل د/B009` supplies residence and staying in a place, reinforced by fixed `ء م ن/B001` settled security. Later `ر د د/B001` supplies return to another place or state and `س ف ل/B004` directed descent (95:5). **Structural cue:** a lexically stable, secure place immediately precedes the human’s best formation and subsequent downward transfer. **Assigned role:** the city is the stationary reference point against which the human trajectory becomes visible. **Abductive move:** the packet supplies stability and displacement but not their comparative function; I infer that the oath calibrates human instability against a settled civic station. **Reading change:** “this secure city” becomes an anchoring measure in the surah’s spatial logic, not merely one more object sworn by.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 95:6 supplied the decisive retrospective activation by repeating `ء م ن` as *āmanū*: security in 95:3 became enacted trust rather than a static property of land. Then *dīn* in 95:7 and doubled `ح ك م` in 95:8 exposed a second relation not obvious at first reading: the bounded trustworthy place can function as a jurisdiction whose social order culminates in adjudication.

findings.text: Şehrin güvenilirliği, ileride inananlardan söz edilince, dışarıdaki güvenliğin insanın içinde güvene ve doğrulamaya dönüşmesinin örneği olur.
Sınırları belirli ve güvenilir şehir, ödül, hesap ve hüküm dizisiyle, sorumluluğun işlediği korunan bir yargı alanı niteliği kazanır.
Yerleşip kalma anlamı, hemen ardından gelen insanın aşağıya taşınmasına karşı şehri sabit bir ölçü noktası yapar.
Şehrin toz, açık arazi ve mezarlık çağrışımları, güvenli yerin insanın aşağı dönüşündeki toprak sonunu da içinde taşıdığı ihtimalini açar.
Şehir adındaki göğüs ve ön boşluk anlamı, güvenli yeri insan bedeninin korunan merkezi gibi okumaya imkân verir.
Şaşkınlık, çöküş ve donukluk anlamları, güvenliğin inkâr karşısında zihinsel çözülmeye dönüşebilen bir karşı yüzü bulunduğunu düşündürür.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A measured form is brought into visible integrity, held upright, and remains liable to return and lowering.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Human proportion extends into the mechanics of standing, structural support, restoration, and directed descent.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Measured Human Formation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A human form is measured, created, completed, beautified, and set in rectitude.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: measured design `خ ل ق:B001/m01`, creative bringing-forth `خ ل ق:B002/m01`, completed visible form `خ ل ق:B003/m01`, human creature `ء ن س:B001/m01`, desirable beauty `ح س ن:B001/m01`, broad robust body `ب ل د:B008/m01`, rectitude and evenness `ق و م:B008/m01`, upright stature `ق و م:B011/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Measurement precedes creation, creation resolves into a perceptible human figure, and beauty coincides with straightness and proportion. Broad bodily robustness and upright stature make the well-set form visible as both balanced outline and sustaining build.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Claims, conduct, and obligations are entrusted to an authority that distinguishes truth, assigns judgment, and brings a final account.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Final judgment reaches into arbitration, testimony, counterfeit rejection, fabricated speech, and the contrast between penetrating and weak counsel.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Delegated Judgment and Credited Testimony
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A person is trusted, authorized to decide, and either credited or charged with falsehood.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: delegated arbitration `ح ك م:B005/m01`, crediting testimony or oath `د ي ن:B007/m01`, assent and belief `ء م ن:B002/m01`, attribution of falsehood `ك ذ ب:B002/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Trust grants standing to a witness or arbiter, delegated judgment gives that standing practical force, and attribution of truth or falsehood determines whether the entrusted word remains authoritative.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Inner disposition aligns with worship, belief, upright conduct, benefaction, and the possibility of religious return or rupture.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Religious alignment is rendered as inward character, straightness, beneficial action, apostasy, divine favor, and the destructive social act of recounting a favor.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Faith, Good Work, and Beneficence
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Belief becomes intentional sound action and exceeds bare correctness through beneficence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: assent and faith `ء م ن:B002/m01`, intentional action `ع م ل:B001/m01`, rectitude in deed `ص ل ح:B001/m01`, beneficent action `ح س ن:B002/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Faith supplies settled assent, work converts assent into action, and rectitude defines the action as sound. Beneficence carries the process beyond avoidance of فساد into active good done well.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Inner disposition aligns with worship, belief, upright conduct, benefaction, and the possibility of religious return or rupture.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Religious alignment is rendered as inward character, straightness, beneficial action, apostasy, divine favor, and the destructive social act of recounting a favor.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Benefaction and Reproachful Reminder
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A favor creates trust and benefit, but repeated self-credit can burden the recipient and undo the social value of the gift.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: benefaction `م ن ن:B003/m01`, reproachful recounting `م ن ن:B003/m02`, generous good `ح س ن:B002/m03`, trust and security `ء م ن:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Benefaction establishes a relation of good and security. Recounting the favor shifts the gift from benefit to pressure, producing a moral reversal in which speech after the act can destroy the act's social integrity.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifade bir yerde kalmayı, orayı terk etmeyip yerleşmeyi ve bu durumda olan kişiyi tutarlı biçimde verir. Yere fiziksel olarak yapışma ve memlekete dönme isteği bu eylemin parçası değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal bir yerde kalıp ikamet etmeyi kapsar; yere temas edip yapışmayı, yalnızca bir yere varmayı veya oraya dönmeyi içermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kalma eylemi yer belirten tamamlayıcıyla kurulur; kişi adı ise orada oturanı gösterir. Bu yapılar fiziksel yapışma anlamına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir yerde kalmak, orayı terk etmeyip orada ikamet etmektir; aynı anlam alanındaki kişi adı, o yerde oturan ve kalan kimseyi gösterir.

facets.statement: Bir yerde bulunmayı sürdürmek ve orayı terk etmeden kalmak çekirdektir.
Bu eylemi sürdüren kişi, bulunduğu yerde oturan kimse olarak adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bir yerde kalma ve orayı sürekli tutma anlamında birleşir; kişi biçimi de aynı yerle ilişkisini sürdüren sakini gösterir. Kalışın süresi veya yere fiziksel temas zorunlu değildir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin bir yeri terk etmeyip orada ikamet etmesi anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kalma ve ikamet etme eylemini korur.
error_profile.loses: O yerde oturan kişiyi adlandıran türemiş anlamı dışarıda bırakır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifade kişinin kendini yere atmasını veya yere yapışmasını ve yere yapışık eski havuz kullanımını destekler. Çökme yorumu kaynak ifadesinin ötesine geçtiğinden dışarıda tutulmalı; bu fiziksel temas da bir yerde ikamet etme anlamından ayrılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yere fiziksel olarak uzanma veya yapışmayı ve yere yapışık eski havuzu kapsar; çökme veya aynı yerde yaşamayı sürdürme anlamını içermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kişinin yere yapışması yer tamamlayıcılı kalıba bağlıdır; eski su yapısı için kullanılan ad ise ayrı bir nesne kullanımını gösterir ve genel ikamet anlamına açılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin kendini yere atarak yere uzanması veya yere yapışmasıdır. Aynı ad, yere yapışık eski havuz için de kullanılır.

Yere yapışık eski havuz aynı fiziksel ilişkiyle adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yere atılma ve yere yapışma eyleminde birleşir. Yere yapışık eski havuza verilen ad, bu özel nesne kullanımını aynı fiziksel çekirdeğe bağlar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifade iki tarafın kılıç veya sopalarla karşılıklı vuruşmasını doğrudan verir; yerde tutunarak savaşma açıklaması ise olası bir türetim yorumudur. Bu yorum eylemin zorunlu parçası yapılmadan dal korunabilir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak biçim karşılıklı silahlı vuruşma anlamıyla tanımlanır; olası yerle bağlantı eylemin zorunlu koşulu sayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: İki tarafın kılıç veya sopalarla birbirine karşılıklı vurup çatışmasıdır. Savaşçıların yerde tutunarak dövüşmesiyle kurulan bağlantı, anlamın kendisi değil olası bir türetim açıklamasıdır.

facets.statement: Tarafların kılıç veya sopalarla birbirine karşılıklı vurması çekirdek eylemdir.
Yerde tutunup onun üzerinde savaşma düşüncesi, eyleme ilişkin olası bir türetim açıklamasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kılıç ve sopalarla karşılıklı vuruşma anlamında birleşir. Eylemin yerde tutunarak savaşmadan türediği görüşü açıklayıcı bir öneridir ve çatışmanın zorunlu koşulu değildir.

morphemes_tsv.note: ayah attribution taken from qac_ref, with non-surah rows and standalone basmala ayah marker rows (1:0) filtered out | dropped_preface_rows=7

word_morpheme_spans.note: word_analysis critical words are orthographic/analytic units, not QAC words; each resolves to a MORPHEME SPAN. The upstream aligned_qac_word_ref is preserved verbatim in word_analysis and is NOT corrected here -- renumbering would fabricate identities (PRINCIPLES.md §11 / basmalah no-hidden-renumbering rule). Use word_morpheme_spans for any word-level join to QAC.

word_analysis_qac_alignment.note: aligned_qac_word_ref does NOT resolve against qac_morphemes for this ayah: word-analysis counts orthographic words where QAC counts morphological words. Word-level joins between word_analysis topics and QAC morphology are UNRELIABLE here. Upstream defect in quran-data's word-analysis; deliberately not auto-repaired (renumbering would fabricate identities).

channel_review.note: first-pass blind review by a single reader; no adjudication, no accept/reject, no per-ayah channel maturity. Not a channel ledger.

channel_generated_outputs.note: Generated network-v3 channel discovery/family/path outputs are available as external quran-data files; read them only when channel detail is necessary, and do not treat them as an adjudicated channel ledger.

full_context_packet.note: surah-scope fallback: the default commentary workflow does not consume per-ayah focus packets, so the source packet is scoped by this builder to roots this ayah can justify and carries no staged reveal order

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

v12_reader_responses.note: Per-ayah focus-run reader responses are retired from the default commentary workflow. Use regular reader walks, plus/minus-5 reader walks, and cross-run publication findings for corpus-wide reader-derived evidence.

v12_cross_run_publication.note: Compact final cross-run findings for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader runs; use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose.

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained. Dictionary/gloss branches are kept in full for every included Furuq root target.

branch_policy.note: No branch filtering is applied. Every branch present in each included dictionary/gloss root entry is kept.

root_mapping.policy: Use the dominant Furuq root for every QAC root, and include non-dominant Furuq targets as additional root_lexicon entries when qac-furuq-v4-root-map marks the QAC root as split.

root_lexicon.note: Turkish is the only language with dictionary entries/glosses currently sourced.
